title: Rehabilitation and Human Services, B.S. (College of Education)
notes: University Park, single track. Built from the archived 2025-26 bulletin. Verified against the page's own printed per-term subtotals. Confirmed byte-identical, row-for-row, to RHS-2024.json's archived page (both the Program Requirements/Course List and Suggested Academic Plan tabs) -- 2025-26 is the last catalog year before the significant 2026-27 curriculum restructuring (RHS 100/300/301/302 resequencing into Years 1-2, RHS 493 finally added to the plan table itself, explicit GEN ED domain labels replacing the generic 'Arts or Humanities'/'Quantification'/'Natural Science'/'Health and Physical Activity' text) that RHS-2026.json's own notes document. Same two real Course-List-vs-Suggested-Plan staleness gaps as 2023/2024 persist unchanged: RHS 493 is a real prescribed course (Course List) but is missing from the Fourth Year Fall row of the displayed plan -- modeled here via the same 'Elective/Minor'-slot substitution used in RHS-2023.json/RHS-2024.json (same credit value, no net credit change); and the 'Health and Physical Activity' 1.5cr x2 slots are pre-reform-era text left over in the plan table with no current-system Gen Ed domain of their own -- mapped to gen_ed:GHW per this session's established EDPP-2026.json convention. RHS 100/300/301/302 sequencing (RHS 100 Year 2 Fall; RHS 300 and RHS 301 both Year 2 Spring; RHS 302 Year 3 Fall, natively concurrent with the EDPSY 101/STAT 100/STAT 200 course in the same term) matches 2022/2023/2024, not 2026's later resequencing. Total credits per the page's footer: 113-121, matching 2023/2024/2026. Everything else (BIOL/ANTH/BISC natural-science alternatives, PSYCH 212/HDFS 239/EDPSY 10 alternative, PSYCH 100/270, SOC 119N, CAS 100A, ENGL 15/30H and 202A/202B, EDUC 100, core RHS course numbers/titles, post-reform Gen Ed model, CI 185/SOC 1 alternative already shown in the plan table, 2.0 GPA entrance requirement) is byte-identical to 2024 and 2026. 'etm' marks the same gateway courses 2026 marks. No campus-availability check performed on this archived page (out of scope for a historical-year build).
